_comment: Pruneroo — see docs/deployment.md in the repository. PTDL_v2 is the format Pelican imports; it is what the whole pelican-eggs library ships.
name: Pruneroo
author: evan.dayton.sizemore@gmail.com
description:
Pruneroo: a unified insight dashboard over DemocracyCraft's four APIs.

Clones the repo, runs npm ci + next build on install, applies migrations on start, then serves Next on the allocated port. The background sync worker runs in-process (src/instrumentation.ts), so this is one server, not two.

Needs an external Postgres 17 — the panel's own database feature is MySQL/MariaDB only. Give it at least 3 GB of memory (next build) and 5 GB of disk (node_modules + .next).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Pruneroo install: clone the repo, then hand off to deploy/pelican/install.sh
# in the repo, which does npm ci + next build.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates > /dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

REPO="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
[[ "${REPO}" == *.git ]] || REPO="${REPO}.git"

# Private repo: a fine-grained PAT or deploy token with read access. It is baked
# into the remote URL so the startup script's `git fetch` keeps working.
if [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    REPO="https://${GIT_USERNAME:-x-access-token}:${GIT_TOKEN}@$(echo "${REPO}" | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "[install] existing checkout, resetting to origin/${GIT_BRANCH}"
    git remote set-url origin "${REPO}"
    git fetch --prune origin "${GIT_BRANCH}"
    git reset --hard "origin/${GIT_BRANCH}"
elif [ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${REPO}" /mnt/server
else
    echo "[install] /mnt/server is not empty, cloning alongside"
    git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${REPO}" /tmp/pruneroo
    cp -a /tmp/pruneroo/. /mnt/server/
    rm -rf /tmp/pruneroo
fi

bash /mnt/server/deploy/pelican/install.sh

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: HTTPS URL of the Pruneroo repository to deploy. The upstream repository is public, so it clones anonymously.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: Branch to deploy.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Leave blank. Only needed if you deploy from a private fork.

variables.name: Git token
variables.description: Leave blank. Only needed if you deploy from a private fork: a read-only deploy token, stored in the remote URL in .git/config so the startup git fetch keeps working.

variables.name: Auto update on start
variables.description: 1 = git fetch + reset --hard to the branch on every start, rebuilding if the revision changed. 0 = run whatever is on disk.

variables.name: Run migrations on start
variables.description: 1 = apply Drizzle migrations and re-apply views.sql before starting. Leave on: both are idempotent.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Postgres connection string. From inside the container the Wings bridge gateway is the host, e.g. postgres://pruneroo:PASSWORD@172.18.0.1:5432/pruneroo

variables.name: Realty base URL
variables.description: Realty API base.

variables.name: Analytics base URL
variables.description: Analytics (Plan) API base.

variables.name: Treasury base URL
variables.description: Treasury API base.

variables.name: Punishments base URL
variables.description: Punishments API base.

variables.name: Treasury token
variables.description: JWT from /treasuryapi personal issue or /treasuryapi business issue. Required for /prune — balances have no other source. A BUSINESS key gets 5x the rate quota.

variables.name: Analytics username
variables.description: Plan webserver login. Required for 30-day playtime; without it inactivity reports `unmeasured`.

variables.name: Analytics password
variables.description: Plan webserver password.

variables.name: Forum eviction listing URL
variables.description: HTML thread listing for eviction reports (not the RSS feed).

variables.name: Forum archive listing URL
variables.description: Archived (previous) eviction reports.

variables.name: Forum region world
variables.description: World that plot names in eviction reports refer to. Matching is scoped to it.

variables.name: Forum cookie
variables.description: xf_user cookie from a logged-in browser session, e.g. xf_user=123,abcdef... Guests get 403 on the eviction forum.

variables.name: Eviction resolved prefixes
variables.description: Comma-separated thread prefixes that mean a report is finished. Anything else counts as active. /sync lists the prefixes actually observed.

variables.name: App base URL
variables.description: Public URL of this dashboard, used to link Discord alerts back to the page that explains them.

variables.name: Discord webhook: punishments
variables.description: Webhook for new bans/mutes. Blank disables just this channel. The first run of a newly set webhook seeds silently — it never replays history.

variables.name: Discord webhook: prune
variables.description: Webhook for dormant players holding a balance.

variables.name: Discord webhook: at-risk
variables.description: Webhook for at-risk plots.

variables.name: Discord prune alert floor
variables.description: Balance a dormant player must exceed to be announced. Far above PRUNE_MIN_BALANCE on purpose.

variables.name: Discord items per message
variables.description: Embeds per message. 10 is Discord's hard cap.

variables.name: Discord items per run
variables.description: Items announced per run, per channel. Bounds a burst; the remainder goes out next run.

variables.name: Sync worker enabled
variables.description: true or false. false runs the web UI only — no background crawling. Exactly one process may run the worker; a second is refused by an advisory lock.

variables.name: Inactivity threshold (hours)
variables.description: Default 30-day playtime below which a player counts as inactive. Overridable per request in the UI. The 30-day window itself is fixed upstream.

variables.name: Prune inactivity (days)
variables.description: How long since last login makes a player dormant.

variables.name: Prune minimum balance
variables.description: Exclusive floor for the /prune list: the rule is balance > this, so 0 means any credit.

variables.name: Prune sweep batch
variables.description: Players priced per treasury.prune.sweep pass (one pass a minute). The pacing dial for the balance backfill — raising it means a heavier sustained load on someone else's game server.

variables.name: Prune sweep concurrency
variables.description: Players worked on at once. Does NOT raise the request rate — the shared throttle caps treasury at 2 requests in flight regardless. Above ~4 there is nothing to gain.

variables.name: Prune balance batch
variables.description: Stored balances re-read per pass.

variables.name: Prune balance max age (hours)
variables.description: How stale a stored balance may get before it is re-read.

variables.name: Prune page size
variables.description: Rows per page on /prune. Display only — the page makes no upstream requests.
